title: Past futures of the book
note: One record per speculation. Labels must match the codebook exactly; the site warns about any it does not recognise. v0.3: reach removed; spatial distance (Here, Elsewhere, Everywhere) is distance from the speaker; Speculative designer renamed Designer. v0.4: 15 speculations added from 7 papers in the ACM extension (ids 32–46); each carries its paper ID from the screening sheet. v0.5: Robot and Game added as media; Workshop participants added as a speaker; one speculation per speaker per work (widest scope, ties to the earliest): repeats across works moved to book-repeats.json; distinct speculations within one work all count. Temporal distance is coded in five-year steps (0–5, 6–10, 11–15, 16–20, 20+ years, Unstated), with the stated horizon in years kept as horizon_years where a year or number is given. Scope is read from what a speculation leaves behind: nothing, a practice, a medium or an institution.
